Dental Check-up Camp – Saphale Service Project
Date: 22nd July 2026
Location: Zilla Parishad School, Rodkhad & Kanderpure Villages, Saphale
As part of its commitment to promoting health and well-being among underprivileged children, the Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo successfully organized a Dental Check-up Camp for students of the Zilla Parishad School in Rodkhad and Kanderpure villages, Saphale.

The camp benefited 300 school children, providing them with comprehensive oral health screening and creating awareness about the importance of maintaining good dental hygiene. For many of the children, this was their first-ever dental examination, making the initiative particularly significant and impactful.

The participating dental professionals conducted individual oral health assessments, identified cases requiring further treatment, and educated the students on proper brushing techniques, oral hygiene practices, and preventive dental care.
